This barley plot is small and it is my own land, so I will try to manage it carefully with the family labor we have. If fertilizer is available from the cooperative, I will use a little chemical fertilizer and also some manure, but I will keep using the seed I know from my own stock because improved seed is hard to get and costs more. I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I do not expect to spray chemicals on this barley plot.
